I am Auntie Wang, 58, and I have farmed these 10.1 mu in Quzhou for forty years. My two children work in the city now, so it is just my husband and me on the land. Because I finished high school, I read the fertilizer bags carefully and I talk with the agro-tech station people when they come to the village. But I still trust my own eyes more than any leaflet.

**Wheat (winter, about 10.1 mu):** I sow in early October after maize is off. I use Jimai 22 or Shiluan 02-1 — improved varieties everyone around here uses, about 15 kg seed per mu since I drill late sometimes. Before sowing I spread compound fertilizer 15-15-15 at roughly 50 kg/mu as base — that gives me about 7.5 kg N, 7.5 P2O5, 7.5 K2O. Then at jointing in early March I topdress urea about 20 kg/mu (≈9 kg N). So total N around 16-17 kg/mu, P around 7-8, K around 7-8. I know the extension people say 14 kg N is enough, but wheat here responds well and I would rather spend 30 yuan more than see pale leaves in April.

I irrigate from my well 3 times: before winter (dong shui), at jointing with the topdressing, and at grain filling if May is dry. Pesticide: one round for aphids and powdery mildew at heading, plus a herbicide in spring — call it 2 applications. I rotary-till after maize residue is chopped. I expect about 500 kg/mu — last three years I got between 480 and 520.

**Maize (summer, 10.1 mu):** Right after wheat harvest in mid-June I direct-seed Zhengdan 958 or Denghai 605 — hybrid, about 2.5 kg seed per mu, no-till into the wheat stubble since the straw stays as mulch. Base fertilizer at sowing: compound 15-15-15 around 40 kg/mu. Then topdress urea 25 kg/mu at the big flare stage (V10-V12). Total N about 17 kg/mu, P around 6, K around 6. Maize here is greedy and if I skimp I lose 50 kg yield easy.

I irrigate twice usually — once after sowing to get emergence, once at tasseling. Pesticide: 1 spray for corn borer and armyworm, sometimes a second if fall armyworm shows up, so count 2. No tillage. Yield target 600 kg/mu — that's normal for our plots with well water.

Total fertilizer bill roughly: wheat 90 kg compound + 20 kg urea × 10 mu, maize 40 kg compound + 25 kg urea × 10 mu. Around 3,500-4,000 yuan for the year on fertilizer alone. Seeds maybe 800 yuan total. I keep it steady — same as last year because last year worked.
